svg.title: Runtime architecture of the cobuilder-memory design: the person, the Claude Code session and its forks, the skills that call the moment tool, the proposed hooks module, Haiku, Hindsight, and the data stores
svg.text: cobuilder-memory runtime architecture, a prediction from ADR-0039

g.title: client boundary: the person who uses the session
Person: submits each prompt and runs /memory
infra boundary: Claude Code 2.1.296, an external engine with an early-access mod API
Claude Code session: the main loop fires each function hook and reads each memory note
Plan fork: $.model.fork sees the whole session and has no tools
Fork agent: $.agent.spawn with subagentType fork keeps the session tools
external boundary: the Haiku model and the Hindsight MCP server
Haiku model: answers the router call, one call per prompt and per stop
Hindsight MCP server: bank coding-agent-{repo}. Read tools: recall, reflect, get_memory, get_document, list_tags, get_bank_stats. Write tools: retain, delete_document.
skills district boundary: the architect and implement skills that call the moment tool
architect design mode: stage 0 calls design-start, and an approved design calls design-approved
implement build skill: calls implement-start, epic-design, and slice-accepted, and retires H1 to H5
cobuilder-memory boundary: the proposed plugin and its one function-hooks module (ADR-0039)
Router: one Haiku call per prompt and per stop through $.model.complete with references/router.md. Read label none, recall, or reflect. Write label none or retain.
Quick run: $.model.fork writes a JSON plan, then the module makes each Hindsight call and keeps 12 results at most
tool.call guard: allows Read, recall, reflect, get_memory, get_document, list_tags, and get_bank_stats for the fork agent id, and denies every other call
moment tool: mcp__cobuilder-memory__moment, registered with $.tool.register. A read moment starts a deep run. A write moment starts a quick run with retain set.
Deep run: starts the fork agent with references/deep-run.md and marks each claim confirmed, contradicted, not applied, or cannot check
adapter modules: each engine call sits behind one adapter module
cc-memory-mirror: one Hindsight document, memory-file:<file name>, for each file of the automatic memory folder
Note and receipt writer: appends one memory note with $.session.append and writes one receipt for each run
references: router.md, plan.md, and deep-run.md, read at session start from $.plugin.root
data boundary: the stores the module reads and writes
cc-memory-mirror state: the $.store key cobuilder-memory:cc-memory-mirror:<bank> maps each file name to its sha256
Receipts folder: one JSON receipt for each run under .cobuilder-memory/runs/, which git ignores
Automatic memory folder: Claude Code keeps it, and the engine memory writer adds files
The repo: the fork agent may Read it, and the guard denies each write
edges: each edge names its protocol or its concern
legend: badge, border, and shape meanings
